name: native-appearance-detection
description: Use appearance detected by the startup extension before falling back to terminal escape-sequence probes.

replacements.old: async function detectTerminalThemeForAuto({ui,timeoutMs,env:env2}){let colorSchemePromise;try{colorSchemePromise=ui.queryTerminalColorScheme?.({timeoutMs})}catch{}let backgroundThemePromise=detectTerminalBackgroundTheme({ui,timeoutMs,env:env2});try{let colorScheme=await colorSchemePromise;if(colorScheme)return colorScheme}catch{}return(await backgroundThemePromise).theme}
replacements.new: async function detectTerminalThemeForAuto({ui,timeoutMs,env:env2}){let appearance=process.env.PI_APPEARANCE_THEME;if(appearance==="light"||appearance==="dark")return appearance;let colorSchemePromise;try{colorSchemePromise=ui.queryTerminalColorScheme?.({timeoutMs})}catch{}let backgroundThemePromise=detectTerminalBackgroundTheme({ui,timeoutMs,env:env2});try{let colorScheme=await colorSchemePromise;if(colorScheme)return colorScheme}catch{}return(await backgroundThemePromise).theme}
